Falun Gong, also known as Falun Dafa, is a spiritual practice that originated in China in the 1990s. It combines meditation and qigong exercises with a moral philosophy centered on the tenets of truthfulness, compassion, and tolerance. Introduced by Li Hongzhi, the practice includes five sets of gentle exercises and teachings aimed at improving physical and mental well-being. 

Practitioners emphasize personal cultivation of character and living in harmony with these principles. It is practiced by people in many parts of the world, often in group settings or individually. If you're interested, I can suggest further reading or resources to explore its philosophy and exercises in more detail.
